notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/5069395935034052798/692F36D0F84D458BADC8D26773C6ADD6B74E7B06/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[i][b]Thank you so much for your support and encouragement as we pave the path where no Eggnog game has gone before! We look forward to hearing feedback and watching you play our new content. There won't be any substantial updates until perhaps next December. However, we will still be rolling out minor bug fixes and content in the coming weeks to address some stuff we didn't have a chance to complete for this update.[/b][/i]

[h1]What's new in this update?[/h1]

[h2]A new home![/h2]
You now have a home! At the end of each shift, you drive home and spend some time browsing your computer or doing other household tasks. This involves a new transition scene and a home scene. Here's everything that can be done in our new home scene:
[list]
[*]Purchase upgrades for your workstation
[*]Communicate via email to your competitors, boss, and other exciting characters
[*]Purchase cosmetic tweaks for your workstation and your home
[*]Play a mini-game
[*]Manage your finances
[/list]
[h2]More days, more drama![/h2]
Previously there were 10 work days that took 6 minutes of real-time to complete. Now, 15 work days take 5 minutes of real-time to complete. This helps us slow down the pace of new eggnogs, new tools, and new information to keep track of. As a consequence of this, we have implemented the following things:
[list]
[*]More voice lines! Roughly 15% more voice lines have been recorded. Existing voice lines have all been overhauled to sound a little bit different.
[*] Going to sleep during your shift is optional; you can choose to continue working and potentially earn more money.
[/list]
[h2]Other awesome changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added two new cities to choose from. Welcome to Santiago and Berlin!
[*]Added Christmas lights to all scenes
[*]Added more objects to change color based on your selection
[*]Added a discord button to the title screen to socialize with all eggnog enthusiasts
[*]Refactored the flaps containing eggnog information, fixing alignment, size, and mixel issues
[*]The desk has been redone to eliminate mixels and make it look a little bit cozier
[*]Lighting and color correction in all scenes have been tweaked to be a bit more moody
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 7.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 7.0[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added a "Credits" button to the title screen
[*]Fixed issue with bomb that was making it impossible to stick a sticker onto it.
[*]Fixed alignment of some text elements in the later levels
[*]Increased the frequency of the Magical Poster's sparkles
[*]Added some more people to the credits, including more YouTubers
[/list]

Onwards to towards the eventually content update. We're still aiming to release German and Spanish localization AND additional content to give the player greater agency over their day.

Thank you for all of the continued support and thank you for supporting indie game developers! If you've enjoyed the game until now, consider leaving a review. It is incredibly helpful, and more importantly, pleasant to read.

As always, feel free to reach us at our [url=https://twitter.com/BluePinStudio1]twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/SKd5Vg2]discord[/url] or comment on this event. :)

notes.title: Another Winter 2021 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 4.0[/h1]

Second part of our series of updates over the next few months targetted at making the game more fun and adding features! Here's what changed this time around :

[list]
[*][b]Checkpoints[/b]! Now when you lose, you can either choose to collect the ending badge or retry!
[*]Fingerprint scanner is 50% faster than before.
[*]Small changes to the hitboxes of various in-game elements. Making it easier to quickly perform the tasks.
[*]Two new achievements to unlock! One is related to the new retry system and the other is related to the credits!
[*]Added a bunch of extra people to the credits, including YouTubers & Streamers who played the game!
[/list]

Thank you all so much for playing our game and we look forward to seeing some of you, along with hopefully some new players, check out the stuff we have in store this winter season!

As always, feel free to reach us at our [url=https://twitter.com/BluePinStudio1]twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/SKd5Vg2]discord[/url]!

notes.title: Big Winter Update Coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone![/h1]

The winter is still a few months away, but it's quickly approaching. We are still in the process of making some decisions about the gameplay behind the scenes but here's what i can share so far!

[list]
[*]Localization is coming! So far, we're certain about Spanish and also looking into German
[*]New gameplay loop that the player will do in between grading eggnogs
[*]Unlockable upgrades will also be available for the main game, primarily unlocking with your performance in the new gameplay loop
[*]More cities to chose from, more weather effects and other superficial changes!
[/list]

Thank you all so much for playing our game and we look forward to seeing some of you, along with hopefully some new players, check out the stuff we have in store this winter season!

As always, feel free to reach us at our [url=https://twitter.com/BluePinStudio1]twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/SKd5Vg2]discord[/url]!

[*] Some sound effects were not connected to Sound Effects volume slider, they have been properly connected now.
[/list]

notes.title: The Gold Version is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 2.0 The Gold Version[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are now consequences for your actions. If the CEO likes you, he will reward you. If he doesn't like you... well I hope you don't have to find out.
[*] Added over [b]70 new voice lines[/b]!
[*] 3 new Steam achievements.
[*] Added new sounds effects.
[*] There are now two full length music tracks available in game.
[*] A lot of new art for objects that were bland.
[*] A new creature lurking in your office.
[*] A few little Easter eggs and references
[*] ...and likely more things that I'm forgetting
[/list]

If you didn't get a chance yet, check out an interview that Todd Mitchell did with me on his podcast GameDev Breakdown : 
https://codewriteplay.com/2021/02/18/viktor-from-blue-pin-studio/

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made collision boxes even more generous
[*] Fixed slight menu problems
[*] Fixed some tutorials not firing in the right order
[*] The event on Day 5 is less frustrating
[*] Entire game has had a font change to prepare for localization.
[*] ...and likely more things that I'm forgetting
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
We will be taking a slight break from content updates for Eggnog Incorporated until Eggnog Season (Winter 2021). We will of course still fix any issues players report to us.

For the next major update we will be adding more in-game days of content. Some intrigue with Doctor Wafer and Chocolate Lightning, and localization to at least [b]Spanish[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b].
